definitions: A specific celestial body or entity, often associated with malevolent or powerful forces in certain mythologies or fictional universes.
A designation for a character or concept within a narrative, implying a blend of divine or cosmic origin with a demonic or rebellious nature.
examples: The prophecy spoke of the rise of the Heavenly Fiend Star.
Many feared the power of the Heavenly Fiend Star.
The ancient texts detailed the influence of the Heavenly Fiend Star on mortal realms.
